newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spanish prime minister prays for ETA victim.
newsitem.headline: Spanish prime minister prays for ETA victim.

text.p: Spanish Prime Minister Jose Maria Aznar, surrounded by members of his cabinet and hundreds of worshippers, prayed for peace at a mass on Wednesday for a politician murdered by Basque separatist guerrillas.

"There is nothing more human and divine which we can desire ...in this mass for Miguel Angel Blanco than the conversion of those who killed him and those who cultivate this atmosphere of hatred among youth," Madrid's Archbishop Antonio Maria Rouco said at the memorial service held at the cathedral next to the royal palace.
"If this happens, we will find ourselves with all certainty at the beginning of the end of terrorism in our homeland," he added.

ETA, which stands for Basque Homeland and Freedom, kidnapped and killed 29-year-old Miguel Angel Blanco after the government refused its demand for a prisoner transfer. Blanco was a Basque town councillor for Aznar's Popular Party.
